title: Phantom Blade Zero Is a Must-Play PS5 Game Before GTA 6
description: In the weeks leading up to GTA 6, Phantom Blade Zero emerges as an essential PS5 action title, backed by a glowing six-hour hands-on preview.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Ultimate PS5 Warm-Up Before GTA 6 Arrives

All bets are undoubtedly off once GTA 6 finally releases, completely dominating the gaming landscape and capturing the attention of millions worldwide. However, in the crucial weeks leading up to Rockstar's monumental launch, players are being advised by gaming critics to redirect some of that anticipation toward another massive title: Phantom Blade Zero.

According to a recent deep-dive report by gaming media outlet Push Square, a six-hour hands-on session with the action title during a trip to Beijing, China, revealed it to be one of the most confident and impressive Western debuts from a developer in years. This is far from a novice studio merely finding its footing in the competitive action genre; instead, it is a development team already primed to lead it.

## Unmatched Combat and Boss Encounters

During the extensive gameplay session, the S-GAME title reportedly showcased stellar combat mechanics and unforgettable boss encounters. These standout elements are shaping the game up to be one of the greatest gaming experiences of the year on the PS5 platform. For players looking to fill the time before the inevitable launch of GTA 6, diving into the martial arts-infused world of Phantom Blade Zero appears to be an ideal choice.

While details regarding the Beijing trip are promised to be shared at a later date, the immediate takeaway is clear: the high-octane gameplay and refined polish suggest that S-GAME is delivering a premier action experience that no current-gen console owner should ignore.

## Editor's Take

GTA 6 may be the undisputed heavyweight of the decade, but Phantom Blade Zero proves that elite action games can still carve out their own spotlight. With exceptional combat and fierce boss fights, it stands tall as a modern PS5 masterpiece in the making.
